parties: ACME Solar Holdings Limited (issuer); ICICI Securities and IIFL Capital Services Limited (placement agents); qualified institutional investors (subscribers)
headline: ACME Solar completes ₹2,800 crore QIP in renewable energy play
sum: ACME Solar Holdings, a top-10 renewable energy IPP, completed a ₹2,800 crore Qualified Institutional Placement of equity shares, advised by Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas (issuer) and Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas & Hogan Lovells (placement agents).
implication: QIP pricing mechanics and investor base for renewable energy infrastructure—note the dual placement agent structure (ICICI Securities / IIFL Capital) and international counsel (Hogan Lovells) for regulatory coordination across India and cross-border capital flows in the ESG asset class.
detail: ACME Solar Holdings is one of India's largest renewable energy independent power producers, operating a portfolio spanning solar, wind, battery energy storage systems, hybrid and firm dispatchable renewable energy projects. The QIP brought in capital from qualified institutional investors. Placement agents ICICI Securities and IIFL Capital Services were supported by Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas (on regulatory/disclosure mechanics) and Hogan Lovells (international/cross-border coordination). The issuer's counsel, Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, led on corporate governance and QIP conditions.
